# Can one artist finish this bridal party on time — and what does the booking actually total?

> Free calculator for bridal hair and makeup artists: price the bride and party, add early-start and travel fees, and check one artist can cover the schedule.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
